## VaultV1Actions.redeem property

Prepares a redeem from a VaultV1 (MetaMorpho) contract.

**Signature:**

```typescript
redeem: (params: {
        shares: bigint;
        userAddress: Address;
    }) => {
        buildTx: () => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1RedeemAction>>;
    };
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.shares`<!-- -->: Amount of shares to redeem.

- `params.userAddress`<!-- -->: User address initiating the redeem.
